fr.sorbonne_u.components.hem2026e1.equipments.heater

Interface HeaterInternalControlCI

  • All Superinterfaces:
    fr.sorbonne_u.components.interfaces.ComponentInterface, HeaterConfigurationI, fr.sorbonne_u.components.interfaces.OfferedCI, java.rmi.Remote, fr.sorbonne_u.components.interfaces.RequiredCI
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    HeaterInternalControlConnector, HeaterInternalControlInboundPort, HeaterInternalControlOutboundPort

    public interface HeaterInternalControlCI
extends fr.sorbonne_u.components.interfaces.OfferedCI, fr.sorbonne_u.components.interfaces.RequiredCI, HeaterConfigurationI
    The component interface HeaterInternalControlCI declares the signatures of services used by the thermostat to control the heating by the heater.

    Description

    This component interface declares the same signatures as the ones declared in the interface HeaterInternalControlI and the ones in its inherited interface HeaterTemperatureI.

    Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant

    Created on : 2023-09-15

    Author:
    Jacques Malenfant
